# Siemens WinCC Log & Storage Architect
> Engineering sizing, flash endurance (TBW) validation, tag configurator, and TIA Portal (V14–V21+) / WinCC V7-V8 export tool for Siemens WinCC Unified (SQLite WAL), Comfort/Advanced (RDB/CSV), and Professional (MS SQL Server). Also known as: WinCC Tag Configurator, Конфигуратор тегов WinCC, TIA Portal Tag Generator, Siemens HMI Storage Calculator.

## Core Capabilities
- **WinCC Unified Sizing**: Precise SQLite WAL database sizing, 4 MB segment alignment, circular buffer safety checks (>= 3 segments, 200 MB minimum), and Flash endurance calculation (TBW, P/E cycles, 1.5x write amplification).
- **WinCC Comfort / Advanced**: Sizing and verification for SIMATIC Comfort Panels and PC Runtime Advanced against the 500,000 records per RDB/CSV file limit and 32 GB FAT32 storage ceiling.
- **WinCC Professional & WinCC V7/V8 (SCADA)**: Dual-stream Tag Logging separation (Fast <= 1 min vs Slow > 1 min) with Microsoft SQL Server Express 10 GB limit monitoring.
- **Tag Configurator & Master Tag Hub (TIA Inspector)**: Universal PLC/HMI tag configurator and generator with standardized 30-column XLSX export directly compatible with Siemens TIA Portal V14, V15, V16, V17, V18, V19, V20, and V21+.
- **ISA-18.2 / EEMUA 191 Alarm Rationalization**: Operator workload rate analysis (< 6 alarms/hr normal, <= 12 manageable, > 30 alarm flood advisory).
- **Network Bandwidth (100BASE-TX)**: Calculation of Industrial Ethernet traffic between SIMATIC S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs and WinCC runtime.

## Mathematical Formulas & Engineering Rules
- **SQLite WAL Segment Formula**: Segment_Size = CEIL((Daily_Bytes * (Segment_Hours / 24) * 1.3) / 4 MB) * 4 MB. Discrete 4 MB multiples (minimum 4 MB). Cyclic deletion purges entire 4 MB files, avoiding filesystem fragmentation.
- **Flash Lifespan (TBW) Formula**: Flash_Life_Years = (Capacity_GB * PE_Cycles) / (Daily_GB * 1.5 * 365). Accounts for 1.5x SQLite Write Amplification factor (WAL write + checkpoint merge to DB3 + B-tree index updates).
- **Comfort Panel Hardware Limits**: Max 32 GB SDHC card (FAT32 filesystem), max 500,000 entries per individual log file before requiring a segmented sequence of log files.
- **Flash Endurance Ratings**: Siemens SIMATIC SD (SLC) = 60,000 P/E; Custom pSLC = 20,000 P/E; Industrial USB/SD (MLC) = 3,000 P/E; Consumer USB/SD (TLC) = 1,000 P/E; QLC = 300 P/E.
- **Alarm Flood Definition**: >= 30 alarms per hour per ANSI/ISA-18.2, IEC 62682, and EEMUA 191 standards.

## Official Standards & Siemens SIOS Citations
- Siemens SIOS Entry ID 109772222: SIMATIC WinCC Unified — Sizing and limits
- Siemens SIOS Entry ID 109746939: WinCC Comfort/Advanced segmenting of archives
- Siemens SIOS Entry ID 109810540: TIA Portal Openness HMI Tag Export Structure
- ANSI/ISA-18.2-2016 / IEC 62682:2014: Management of Alarm Systems for the Process Industries
